en.activities.tug_of_war.title: Tug-of-war vs pickleball
en.activities.match_strong.title: Community match vs Pine Crown
en.activities.match_juniors.title: Community match vs Pine Crown (juniors)
en.activities.open_house.title: Open house
en.endings.saved_with_coach.title: Hollow Creek is saved
en.endings.saved_with_coach.body: The board votes to keep the club. Maple Ridge High calls with a job offer, and your coach comes with you.
en.endings.saved_with_kid.title: Hollow Creek is saved
en.endings.saved_with_kid.body: The board votes to keep the club. Maple Ridge High offers you the program, and Mason enrolls there too.
en.endings.saved_alone.title: Hollow Creek is saved
en.endings.saved_alone.body: The board votes to keep the club. You head to Maple Ridge High on your own.
en.endings.club_sold.title: The club is sold
en.endings.club_sold.body: The board votes to sell. The FOR SALE sign stays up, and Hollow Creek closes at the end of the month.
en.endings.sold_to_developer.title: Sold to the developer
en.endings.sold_to_developer.body: You take the money. The courts will be townhouses by spring.
en.endings.bankrupt.title: Out of money
en.endings.bankrupt.body: The club cannot make payroll. The bank takes over and the act ends.
en.events.hc_dale_phone.title: Coach Dale is on his phone during the junior lesson
en.events.hc_dale_phone.body: Tyler is hitting balls into the fence and Mason is sitting on the court. Dale has not looked up in ten minutes.
en.events.hc_dale_phone.options.A: Go to Court 1 and talk to him
en.events.hc_dale_phone.options.B: Text him from the deck · quality +1, reputation −1
en.events.hc_dale_phone.options.C: Let it slide · quality −3, Dale likes you
en.events.hc_parent_complaint.title: Ms. Carter wants a word about the lessons
en.events.hc_parent_complaint.body: "My son paid for lessons, not babysitting." She is standing at the gate of Court 1.
en.events.hc_parent_complaint.options.B: Promise things will change · the board hears sooner
en.events.hc_parent_complaint.options.C: Back the coach · −2 members, reputation −3, Dale tries harder
en.events.hc_board_memo.title: The board wants an answer about the lessons
en.events.hc_board_memo.body: Program quality has collapsed and members are leaving. Dale is still teaching, and the board expects a plan today.
en.events.hc_board_memo.options.A: Hire a second coach · another wage, Dale is hurt
en.events.hc_board_memo.options.B: Give Dale one more chance and watch him on Court 1
en.events.hc_dale_relapse.title: Dale is back on his phone
en.events.hc_dale_relapse.body: One more chance lasted a day. The juniors are hitting balls at each other.
en.events.hc_dale_relapse.options.A: Hire a coach to take over · Dale knows he was replaced
en.events.hc_hire_coach.title: Hire another coach
en.events.hc_hire_coach.body: Three people answered the ad. The new coach becomes head coach and Dale stays on. Whoever you pick could follow you after Hollow Creek.
en.events.hc_discover_kid.title: Mason has a natural swing
en.events.hc_discover_kid.body: The kid who sat on the court during Dale's lessons just hit three clean backhands in a row.
en.events.hc_discover_kid.options.B: Tell his parents he has talent · they will expect lessons
en.events.hc_pickleball_lease.title: The pickleball group wants a full-year lease
en.events.hc_pickleball_lease.body: They offer $800 up front to lock in Court 2 for the year. Your tennis members are not thrilled.
en.events.hc_pickleball_lease.options.C: Offer shared hours (go to Court 2; depends on reputation)
en.events.hc_pickleball_rant.title: The pickleball group is venting in the community chat
en.events.hc_pickleball_rant.body: "Hollow Creek doesn't want new people." The thread has forty replies.
en.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.A: Post a calm reply (depends on reputation)
en.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.C: Kick them out of the chat · old members cheer
en.events.hc_tug_of_war.title: The pickleball team challenges you to tug-of-war
en.events.hc_tug_of_war.body: Loser buys the lemonade. Tennis has never won one of these.
en.events.hc_tug_of_war.options.A: Send the juniors · they miss a lesson
en.events.hc_developer_visit.title: A developer wants to buy the land
en.events.hc_developer_visit.body: $2.1 million for the whole site. Townhouses, he says. The board would take it.
en.events.hc_developer_return.title: The developer is back with a final offer
en.events.hc_developer_return.body: Same money, a firm deadline. This is the last time he asks.
en.events.hc_crow_ball.title: A crow just stole a ball from the basket
en.events.hc_crow_ball.body: It is sitting on the fence post, looking pleased with itself. The juniors are delighted.
en.events.hc_crow_ball.options.A: Laugh it off with the juniors · reputation +1, lesson stalls
en.events.hc_crow_ball.options.B: Put a lid on the basket · −$40
en.events.hc_rival_flyer.title: Pine Crown taped a recruiting flyer to our fence
en.events.hc_rival_flyer.body: "Real coaching. Real courts. 20% off your first month." Three parents have already taken a photo of it.
en.events.hc_rival_flyer.options.A: Swap it for our own flyer
en.events.hc_board_chair.title: The board chair is coming to see the club
en.events.hc_board_chair.body: She will be on the deck at noon. Halfway to the vote, she wants to know whether this is working.
en.events.hc_board_chair.options.A: Show her around yourself (on the deck; depends on board confidence)
en.events.hc_board_chair.options.C: Ask for more money and time · +$600, the board gets impatient
en.events.hc_last_chance.title: A board member offers you a lifeline
en.events.hc_last_chance.body: "The vote is going badly. Give them something to see, or give them a promise."
en.events.hc_last_chance.options.A: Throw an open house this weekend · −$300
en.events.hc_last_chance.options.B: Promise quality back over 50 in three days
en.events.hc_turnaround_check.title: Three days are up
en.events.hc_turnaround_check.body: The board wants to see whether you kept your promise. Quality had to be back over 50.
en.events.hc_storm_tree.title: A storm dropped a tree on Court 1's fence
en.events.hc_storm_tree.body: Branches across the baseline, the fence folded in. Lessons cannot run like this.
en.events.hc_storm_tree.options.A: Pay a crew to clear it now · −$450
en.events.hc_storm_tree.options.B: Get members to help (go to Court 1; depends on reputation)
en.events.hc_storm_tree.options.C: Close Court 1 for now · the court breaks again
en.events.hc_crow_lid.title: The crow has learned to open the lid
en.events.hc_crow_lid.body: It flips the lid with its beak, takes one ball, and leaves. The juniors are cheering for the crow.
en.events.hc_crow_lid.options.A: Let the juniors name it · reputation +2
en.events.hc_rival_van.title: Pine Crown parked a demo van in our lot
en.events.hc_rival_van.body: Free racket demos and 20% off. Our members have to walk past it to get to the courts.
en.events.hc_rival_van.options.A: Ask them to leave (go to the parking lot)
en.events.hc_rival_van.options.B: Set up our own table next to it · −$120
en.events.hc_mason_parents.title: Mason's parents want to know when proper lessons start
en.events.hc_mason_parents.body: "You said he has talent. So what happens now?"
en.events.hc_mason_parents.options.B: Ask your head coach to work with him · lessons suffer a bit
en.events.hc_member_saturday.title: An old member stops you about Saturday mornings
en.events.hc_member_saturday.body: "Saturday 9 to 11 was always tennis. Now it is pickleball."
en.events.hc_member_saturday.options.A: Give tennis Saturdays back · pickleball pressure rises
en.events.hc_member_saturday.options.B: Buy him a coffee and listen (on the deck) · −$10
en.events.hc_volunteer_coach.title: A retired member offers to help coach on weekends
en.events.hc_volunteer_coach.body: He played college tennis forty years ago and still has the forehand.
en.events.hc_volunteer_coach.options.B: Ask him to help recruit instead
en.events.hc_double_booked.title: Court 1 is double-booked this morning
en.events.hc_double_booked.body: Two tennis regulars and four pickleball players are standing at the gate with the same time slot.
en.events.hc_double_booked.options.A: Give it to the tennis regulars · pickleball pressure rises
en.events.hc_double_booked.options.B: Give it to the pickleball group
en.events.hc_double_booked.options.C: Sort it out in person (go to Court 1)
en.events.hc_pool_closes.title: Time to close the pool for the season
en.events.hc_pool_closes.body: The nights are getting cold. Keeping it open another week costs a little, and the families love it.
en.events.hc_pool_closes.options.B: Keep it open one more week · −$60
en.events.hc_pool_closes_late.title: The extra pool week is over
en.events.hc_pool_closes_late.body: The last swimmers are packing up their towels.
en.events.hc_storm_leak.title: The clubhouse roof is leaking
en.events.hc_storm_leak.body: Rain is coming through over the trophy case. Members are moving chairs.
en.events.hc_community_match.title: Community match against Pine Crown
en.events.hc_community_match.body: Pine Crown is the club across the valley. Half the board will be watching.
en.events.hc_community_match.options.A: Field the strongest lineup with your coach
en.events.hc_board_vote.title: The board votes on selling the club
en.events.hc_board_vote.body: Present in person and board confidence decides it; let the numbers speak and program quality and members decide it.
en.events.hc_board_vote.options.A: Present in person on the deck
en.events.hc_board_vote.options.B: Let the numbers speak for themselves
en.events.hc_who_follows.title: Maple Ridge High wants you to run their program
en.events.hc_who_follows.body: You can bring one person with you.
en.events.hc_hiring_day.title: Two people came about the job
en.events.hc_hiring_day.body: The notice has been up for a week and two people turned up. There is always more work than hands.
en.events.hc_hiring_day.options.B: Ben Kim · ball kid, good with people, $110/wk
en.events.hc_hiring_day.options.C: Hire no one · keep the wages
en.events.hc_hiring_day_2.title: Hiring day before autumn
en.events.hc_hiring_day_2.body: The more you fix, the more there is to look after. Two more people came about the job.
en.events.hc_hiring_day_2.options.A: Gus Moreno · veteran groundskeeper, best at upkeep, a bit tired, $260/wk
en.events.hc_hiring_day_2.options.B: Lily Chen · front-desk pro, best with people, $220/wk
en.events.hc_hiring_day_2.options.C: Hire no one · keep the wages
en.log.ball_machine: The ball machine arrived; lessons are sharper now
en.log.started: You took over Hollow Creek Tennis Club.
en.log.workday_thin: Only a handful of neighbors showed up; the clay is still a mess
en.log.roof_fixed: The roof is fixed for good
en.log.vote_passed: The board voted to keep the club
en.log.trial_onsite: you were on Court 1 to welcome them, so a few more signed up
en.log.promise_broken: You broke your promise to the board
en.log.promise_kept: You kept your promise to the board
en.log.tree_cleared: The tree is cleared and lessons go on
en.log.no_hire: No one was hired; the same few people carry the work

en.orders.inflate_bubble.note: New fans $2,000, plus a full day of work

zh.activities.contractor.title: 外包施工队在红土场
zh.activities.tug_of_war.title: 和匹克球队拔河
zh.activities.match_strong.title: 社区对抗赛 vs 松冠俱乐部
zh.activities.match_juniors.title: 社区对抗赛 vs 松冠俱乐部（青少年上场）
zh.activities.open_house.title: 开放日
zh.endings.saved_with_coach.title: 霍洛溪保住了
zh.endings.saved_with_coach.body: 董事会投票保留俱乐部。枫岭高中发来聘书，你的教练跟你一起走。
zh.endings.saved_with_kid.title: 霍洛溪保住了
zh.endings.saved_with_kid.body: 董事会投票保留俱乐部。枫岭高中请你去带网球队，Mason 也考进了枫岭。
zh.endings.saved_alone.title: 霍洛溪保住了
zh.endings.saved_alone.body: 董事会投票保留俱乐部。你一个人去了枫岭高中。
zh.endings.club_sold.title: 俱乐部被卖了
zh.endings.club_sold.body: 董事会投票出售。停车场的出售牌没摘下来，霍洛溪月底关门。
zh.endings.sold_to_developer.title: 卖给了开发商
zh.endings.sold_to_developer.body: 你收了钱。到明年春天，这些球场会变成联排别墅。
zh.endings.bankrupt.title: 钱花光了
zh.endings.bankrupt.body: 俱乐部发不出工资，银行接管，本幕结束。
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.title: Dale 在青少年课上玩手机
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.body: Tyler 把球一个个打进围网，Mason 坐在场地上发呆。Dale 已经十分钟没抬头了。
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.options.A: 去 1 号场当面跟他说
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.options.B: 在露台上给他发短信 · 质量 +1，声望 −1
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.options.C: 算了 · 质量 −3，Dale 记你的好
zh.events.hc_parent_complaint.title: Carter 女士要找你谈课程的事
zh.events.hc_parent_complaint.body: “我儿子交的是课时费，不是托管费。”她就站在 1 号场门口。
zh.events.hc_parent_complaint.options.B: 保证会改 · 董事会会更早来问
zh.events.hc_parent_complaint.options.C: 站在教练一边 · 会员 −2，声望 −3，Dale 会更上心
zh.events.hc_board_memo.title: 董事会要你给课程一个说法
zh.events.hc_board_memo.body: 项目质量崩了，会员在流失。Dale 还在上课，董事会要你今天拿出办法。
zh.events.hc_board_memo.options.A: 再招一位教练 · 多一份工资，Dale 不高兴
zh.events.hc_board_memo.options.B: 再给 Dale 一次机会，你去 1 号场盯着他
zh.events.hc_dale_relapse.title: Dale 又在看手机了
zh.events.hc_dale_relapse.body: 再给一次机会只撑了一天。孩子们在拿球互相打。
zh.events.hc_dale_relapse.options.A: 再招一位教练接课 · Dale 知道自己被替了
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.title: 再招一位教练
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.body: 三个人回了招聘启事。新教练接主教练，Dale 留下来。你选的人，以后可能跟你去下一站。
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.options.A: Jess Park · 热血新人，每周 $250
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.options.B: Walt Hendricks · 疲惫的老手，每周 $420
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.options.C: Nadia Volkov · 前职业球员，每周 $900，签约费 $600
zh.events.hc_discover_kid.title: Mason 的挥拍是天生的
zh.events.hc_discover_kid.body: 在 Dale 课上坐在地上发呆的那个孩子，刚刚连着打了三个干净的反手。
zh.events.hc_discover_kid.options.B: 告诉他父母他有天赋 · 他们会等着你安排
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.title: 匹克球那帮人想签一整年的租约
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.body: 他们先付 $800，把 2 号场包一整年。网球会员不太高兴。
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.options.B: 把 2 号场收回来打网球
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.options.C: 提议分时段（走到 2 号场去谈，成败看声望）
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.title: 匹克球那帮人在社区群里吐槽你
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.body: “霍洛溪不欢迎新人。”帖子底下已经四十条回复。
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.A: 心平气和地回一帖（成败看声望）
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.B: 请他们来打一场友谊赛
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.C: 把他们踢出群 · 老会员叫好
zh.events.hc_tug_of_war.title: 匹克球队向你们发起拔河挑战
zh.events.hc_tug_of_war.body: 输的一方请喝柠檬水。网球这边从来没赢过。
zh.events.hc_tug_of_war.options.A: 派青少年上 · 他们少上一节课
zh.events.hc_tug_of_war.options.B: 你亲自上（走到 2 号场）
zh.events.hc_developer_visit.title: 开发商想买下这块地
zh.events.hc_developer_visit.body: 整块地 210 万美元。他说要盖联排别墅。董事会会同意的。
zh.events.hc_developer_return.title: 开发商带着最后报价回来了
zh.events.hc_developer_return.body: 一样的价钱，有明确的期限。这是他最后一次开口。
zh.events.hc_crow_ball.title: 一只乌鸦从球筐里叼走了一个球
zh.events.hc_crow_ball.body: 它站在围网柱子上，一脸得意。孩子们乐坏了。
zh.events.hc_crow_ball.options.A: 和孩子们一起笑 · 声望 +1，课停了一会儿
zh.events.hc_rival_flyer.title: 松冠把招生传单贴到了我们的围网上
zh.events.hc_rival_flyer.body: 「真正的教练，真正的场地，首月八折。」已经有三位家长拍了照。
zh.events.hc_board_chair.title: 董事会主席要来俱乐部看看
zh.events.hc_board_chair.body: 她中午到露台。离表决还有一半时间，她想知道你这套办法管不管用。
zh.events.hc_board_chair.options.A: 亲自带她转一圈（在露台；成败看董事会信心）
zh.events.hc_board_chair.options.B: 把数字发邮件给她 · 声望 −1
zh.events.hc_board_chair.options.C: 开口要钱要时间 · +$600，董事会会不耐烦
zh.events.hc_last_chance.title: 一位董事想拉你一把
zh.events.hc_last_chance.body: “表决形势不妙。要么让他们看到点什么，要么给他们一个承诺。”
zh.events.hc_last_chance.options.B: 立军令状：三天内质量回到 50 以上
zh.events.hc_turnaround_check.title: 三天到了
zh.events.hc_turnaround_check.body: 董事会来看你有没有兑现承诺：质量要回到 50 以上。
zh.events.hc_storm_tree.title: 暴风雨把一棵树刮倒在 1 号场的围网上
zh.events.hc_storm_tree.body: 树枝横在底线上，围网塌了进去。这样没法上课。
zh.events.hc_storm_tree.options.B: 叫会员一起来清（走到 1 号场，成败看声望）
zh.events.hc_storm_tree.options.C: 先把 1 号场关了 · 场地又坏了
zh.events.hc_crow_lid.title: 乌鸦学会了开盖子
zh.events.hc_crow_lid.body: 它用嘴把盖子掀开，叼走一个球就飞。孩子们在给乌鸦加油。
zh.events.hc_crow_lid.options.A: 让孩子们给它起个名字 · 声望 +2
zh.events.hc_rival_van.title: 松冠把试训车开进了我们的停车场
zh.events.hc_rival_van.body: 免费试拍，打八折。我们的会员去球场得从车旁边走过。
zh.events.hc_rival_van.options.A: 当面请他们离开（走到停车场）
zh.events.hc_rival_van.options.B: 在旁边摆我们自己的桌子 · −$120
zh.events.hc_mason_parents.title: Mason 的父母问什么时候开始正经练
